msg: pg_start_backup() was renamed in PostgreSQL 15 (exclusive backup mode removed)
fix: call pg_backup_start(label, fast) in the same session as pg_backup_stop()

msg: pg_stop_backup() was renamed in PostgreSQL 15
fix: call pg_backup_stop() in the session that ran pg_backup_start()

msg: pg_backup_start_time() was removed in PostgreSQL 15
fix: drop the call; track the start time in your backup tool

msg: pg_is_in_backup() was removed in PostgreSQL 15
fix: drop the call; only non-exclusive backups exist from 15 on

msg: plpython2u / plpythonu were removed in PostgreSQL 15 (Python 2 no longer supported)
fix: port the function to Python 3 and use LANGUAGE plpython3u

msg: server variable stats_temp_directory was removed in PostgreSQL 15
fix: delete the setting (statistics now live in shared memory)

msg: pg_dump --no-synchronized-snapshots was removed in PostgreSQL 15
fix: remove the option

msg: force_parallel_mode was renamed in PostgreSQL 16
fix: use debug_parallel_query

msg: server variable promote_trigger_file was removed in PostgreSQL 16
fix: promote with pg_ctl promote or SELECT pg_promote()

msg: server variable vacuum_defer_cleanup_age was removed in PostgreSQL 16
fix: use hot_standby_feedback or a replication slot

msg: read-only server variables lc_collate and lc_ctype were removed in PostgreSQL 16
fix: read datcollate / datctype from pg_database

msg: pg_walinspect *_till_end_of_wal() functions were removed in PostgreSQL 16
fix: call pg_get_wal_records_info() / pg_get_wal_stats() with an end LSN

msg: creating views manually with ON SELECT rules was removed in PostgreSQL 16
fix: use CREATE VIEW

msg: server variable old_snapshot_threshold was removed in PostgreSQL 17
fix: delete the setting; bound long transactions with idle_in_transaction_session_timeout

msg: db_user_namespace (per-database users) was removed in PostgreSQL 17
fix: create ordinary roles and restrict them with CONNECT privileges

msg: the adminpack contrib extension was removed in PostgreSQL 17
fix: DROP EXTENSION adminpack before the upgrade

msg: server variable trace_recovery_messages was removed in PostgreSQL 17
fix: delete the setting

msg: pg_stat_statements blk_read_time / blk_write_time were renamed in PostgreSQL 17
fix: use shared_blk_read_time / shared_blk_write_time

msg: checkpoint columns were removed from pg_stat_bgwriter in PostgreSQL 17
fix: read them from the new view pg_stat_checkpointer

msg: buffers_backend / buffers_backend_fsync were removed from pg_stat_bgwriter in PostgreSQL 17
fix: use pg_stat_io

msg: pg_collation.colliculocale / pg_database.daticulocale were renamed in PostgreSQL 17
fix: use colllocale / datlocale
